play.definition: A vertical double-move pass concept in which the primary receiver releases upfield, sells an inside slant break, then plants and redirects vertically to create separation from a defender who reacts to the initial inside movement. The quarterback times a deep throw after the receiver transitions back upfield, while complementary routes occupy underneath and deep coverage defenders.

action.label: Close On Quarterback
action.definition: A defender's pass-rush action of reducing the space to the quarterback after defeating or clearing a blocker, moving into immediate pressure or tackling range.

action.label: Pre Snap
action.definition: The period before the snap when players are set in formation and no active play has begun.

action.label: Wrap Quarterback
action.definition: A defender's tackling action of securing the quarterback with the arms or body to prevent escape and initiate the takedown.
